headerSub: Manage local communication with Willo Server

status.title: Connection Status
status.pendingMsg: These requests will be sent automatically upon reconnection.
status.traceNote: This ID is sent to Willo Server (X-Poste-Id header) to ensure medical record traceability.

bonjour.title: Local Discovery (Bonjour / mDNS)
bonjour.desc: The ZeroConf / Bonjour protocol automatically discovers Willo services (_willo._tcp) published on your local network. No manual IP configuration needed if network multicast is allowed.
bonjour.scanning: Searching for servers on the local network...
bonjour.noneMsg: Make sure the Willo server is running on the same local network or try the fallback scanner.

subnet.title: Local Network Scanner (mDNS Fallback)
subnet.desc: If mDNS multicast is blocked by your firewall or switch, the scanner checks each address in the local Class C network range (port 5030) to identify the fallback server.
subnet.noneTitle: No server found via IP scan
subnet.noneMsg: Click Scan to probe the Class C local network and find Willo Server.
